tools.name: build_mappy_itinerary_url
tools.description:
Generates a Mappy deep-link URL for routes, travel times, and multimodal directions (car, public transit, bike, walking, motorbike).
Optimized primarily for France (best results and comprehensive multimodal data) and Europe.
USE WHEN the user asks (in French or English) for: "itineraire", "trajet", "comment aller a", "temps de parcours", "directions", "route", "how to get to", "travel time", by "voiture", "transports", "train", "bus", "tram", "velo", "bike", or "a pied".
Returns a direct clickable Mappy URL with calculated route options.

departure.description: Departure location: address, city, train station, landmark, or point of interest (e.g., "Avenue Jean Jaures 69007 Lyon", "Gare de Lyon Paris", "Eiffel Tower").

arrival.description: Arrival location: address, city, train station, landmark, or point of interest (e.g., "Rue Lecourbe 75015 Paris", "Vieux-Port Marseille", "La Defense").

language.description: Language/locale for the Mappy URL. Recommended: "fr" for French queries (optimal routing data in France), "fr-be" or "nl-be" for Belgium queries and "en" for English. Defaults to website language.
